result.topic_en: Pencil calculations expressing a quantity A (divided by 2π) as a sum of logarithms involving square roots and complex exponentials, with expressions for e^{2δi} in terms of x, a, ψ and φ.
result.transcription:
$-\frac{1}{3}$ [?] $\quad i \cdot 2\pi i$
$A + \frac{2\pi}{\varrho}\partial r + \frac{2\pi}{\varrho_1}\partial r \quad + 2\pi \log \frac{1+\sqrt{1-x^2}}{1-\sqrt{1-x^2}}$

$\frac{A}{2\pi}$

[-$2\pi$-]

$r = \frac{1}{x} e^{(\delta-\psi)i} - a e^{(\delta-\varphi)i}$

$\frac{A}{2\pi} = \log \frac{\sqrt{\frac{1}{x} - x e^{2(\delta-\psi)i} + a e^{(\varphi-\psi)i} + a e^{2\delta-(\varphi+\psi)i}} + \sqrt{\frac{1}{x} - x}}{\sqrt{\quad} - \sqrt{\frac{1}{x} - x}}$

$+ \log ( i \mp -i )$

$+ \log \frac{1+\sqrt{1-x^2}}{1-\sqrt{1-x^2}}$

$e^{2\delta i} = \frac{\frac{1}{x}e^{\psi i} - a e^{\varphi i}}{x e^{-\psi i} - a e^{-\varphi i}}$

$e^{2\delta i} = \frac{x e^{\psi i} - a e^{\varphi i}}{x e^{-\psi i} - a e^{-\varphi i}}$
